items.headline: Seahawks' Darnold 'on a good track' to play vs. Commanders
items.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is "on a good track" to play Sunday against the Commanders, coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday.

items.headline: Seahawks' Macdonald apologizes to Broncos' Payton for comments
items.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.

items.headline: Macdonald says Broncos' Payton accused Seahawks of cheating
items.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the Broncos wrongfully accused Seattle of a Spygate-like cheating scandal in 2024. Denver coach Sean Payton ultimately "backed off" after the Seahawks threatened a lawsuit if the Broncos went public with the allegation.
